letters.subject: Payment reminder: invoice INV-3140
letters.body:
Hello Debbie,

A quick reminder that invoice INV-3140 for £948.00 was due on 30 October 2026 and is now 6 days overdue.

If it has already been paid, thank you, and please ignore this email. If not, could you let me know when payment will be made, by Friday 13 November?

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Second reminder: invoices INV-3091 and INV-3130
letters.body:
Hello Colin,

Our records show two amounts overdue on your account:

Invoice INV-3091: £1,414.20, due on 30 September 2026, now 36 days overdue
Invoice INV-3130: £3,102.00, due on 30 October 2026, now 6 days overdue

Could you arrange payment, or let me know when it will be made, by Friday 13 November? If there is a problem with either invoice, please tell me so we can sort it out.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd

letters.subject: Purchase order number needed for sales order SO-6107
letters.body:
Hello Rob,

We are ready to invoice sales order SO-6107 (SAC305 solder bar, 1kg) for £9,216.00. Your account needs a purchase order number on every invoice, and we don't have one for this order.

Could you send us the PO number, please? We will raise the invoice as soon as we have it, so a reply by Friday 13 November would be appreciated.

Kind regards,
Accounts Administrator
Demo Company Ltd
